PZZ700-200830-
1235 PM PDT Mon Oct 19 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 PM, a 1011 mb high was over the southern Coachella Valley, 
and a 1003 mb low was 300 nautical miles west of central Oregon. 
Weak onshore flow continues today before a coastal eddy likely 
develops tonight and strengthens Tuesday. Southerly flow increases
Wednesday ahead of a storm system that will move through the 
coastal waters bringing rain and a slight chance of thunderstorms 
late Wednesday and early Thursday. Stronger onshore flow from the 
northwest will follow a cold front on Thursday morning, before 
weakening Friday.
